## Introduction


## Article

We found an article that attempts to predict the infection rate of an airborne disease when waiting in a waiting room. They did their study on TB, Measles, and the Flu. They had had specific requirements of room size, ventilation rate, ...

# Assumptions
- Only one infected person in the waiting room
- Once infected, the person can not infect others
- The air being ventilated throught the room is mixed air and infection (not being filtered)

## Replication

We had 2 main going into this project:
- we wanted to test their infection rate they found by changing different variables such as room size and how many people were infected
- we wanted to replicate their Monte Carlo approach and apply it to a different disease (SARS)
